string.text: Smokes restore psy health instead of radiation. Alcohol still restores radiation and also restores psy health. The amount is restored gradually while the item's effect lasts; several items stack. Being drunk boosts psy restore and protects against psy damage.
Master switch for the psy health restore and the tooltip line. Smokes stay without radiation restore even when this is off (that is a config change).

How much psy health smokes restore. One Marlboro cigarette restores: Light 3%, Mild 4%, Medium 5%, Potent 6.5%, Strong 8% of psy health. Other smokes change in the same proportion (a Cuban cigar gives 12% at Medium). Applies to the next smoke.

How much psy health alcohol restores. One sip of Stolichnaya vodka restores: Light 6%, Mild 8%, Medium 10%, Potent 13%, Strong 16% of psy health. Other drinks change in the same proportion (a beer gives 5% at Medium). Applies to the next drink.
Detect smokes and alcohol from other mods
Smokes and alcohol added by other mods also restore psy health: smokes 5%, alcohol 7% per use at Medium. Their radiation restore, if they have one, is not removed.

While you are drunk, psy health restore is raised and part of every psy health loss is given back (settings below). Both grow with how drunk you are: one sip of vodka makes you about 20% drunk. Off: alcohol only restores psy like the other items.

Preset for the slider below. The number is how much faster all psy health restore (items, regeneration, campfires) goes when you are fully drunk: +100% = twice as fast. Tipsy = proportionally less: after one sip of vodka (about 20% drunk) +100% gives +20%.
Extra psy restore at full drunkenness (%)
All psy health restore is raised by this much when you are fully drunk, proportionally less when you are only tipsy. 100 = doubled. 0 = off.

Preset for the slider below. The number is the share of every psy health loss that is given back when you are fully drunk: 50% = half of it. Tipsy = proportionally less: after one sip of vodka (about 20% drunk) 50% gives back 10%.
Psy loss given back at full drunkenness (%)

This share of every psy health loss (psy attacks, psy fields, stress) is given back when you are fully drunk, proportionally less when you are only tipsy. It does not save you from a single lethal psy hit. 0 = off.
Shows in the item tooltip how much psy health one use restores and over how many seconds.
Writes a [PsyRelief] line to the game log for every smoke or drink. For bug reports only.
